Wokeism is the most sophisticated form of racism ever built. Not because it hates one group, but because it reduces every human being to their skin color and calls it justice.

Its roots aren't mysterious. Critical theory from the Frankfurt School, French postmodernists like Foucault and Derrida, then critical legal studies on American campuses, distilled into Critical Race Theory in the 80s and 90s. The core idea: society is nothing but a power struggle between groups. The individual doesn't exist. Merit doesn't exist. Only oppressor and oppressed.

Accept that premise and everything else follows. You're judged by your race before you open your mouth. Your success is privilege, your failure is oppression. That's not anti-racism. That's racism with a PhD.

And look at who actually holds these views. Not most minorities. Only about 3% of Hispanic Americans use "Latinx." Most Black Americans told Gallup they wanted the same or more police presence in their neighborhoods, not less. The "Hidden Tribes" study found the hard progressive activist wing is around 8% of the population, and whiter and wealthier than average. A small radicalized class speaks in the name of minorities who never asked it to.

The coalition doesn't even hold together. Feminists vs trans activists on women's sports. Asian Americans who had to go to the Supreme Court because Harvard discriminated against them in the name of diversity. A framework that keeps producing these contradictions isn't a moral philosophy. It's a hierarchy of grievances.

And none of this grew organically. It's an industry. DEI became a multi-billion dollar market: corporate trainings, consultants, foundation grants, university bureaucracies whose budgets depend on the problem never being solved. Follow the incentives and you find an entire class of people paid to see racism everywhere. Cut the money and it starts collapsing, which is exactly what we've watched since companies began slashing DEI budgets.

Real anti-racism is simple: judge people as individuals. MLK said it in 1963. Everything since that tried to replace it has been a step backwards. https://x.com/teslaownersSV/status/1884471785648972161/video/1

I made a list of 63 of U.S. Senate candidate James Talafreako's most insane and deranged statements.

Sourced and referenced.

1. "Modern science obviously recognizes that there are many more than two biological sexes. In fact, there are six" 2021-04-20, Texas House Public Education Committee

2. "God is non-binary." 2021-10-14, Texas House

3. "Our campaign has officially become a non-meat campaign." 2022-02, Texas Humane Legislation Network fundraiser

4. "I always think of myself as a Christian who hates Christianity, right?" 2021-03-04, Activist Theology

5. "In context of abortion … God asks for Mary's consent … So, to me that is a an affirmation in one of our most central stories, that creation has to be done with consent. You cannot force someone to create." 2025-07-18, The Joe Rogan Experience

6. "Radicalized white men are the greatest domestic terrorist threat in our country." 2021-03-18, Twitter/X

7. "#AhmaudArbery is the latest American killed by the virus of racism. The virus kills our black neighbors if they’re jogging, playing music, sitting in church, selling CDs, or carrying a bag of Skittles... White skin gives me and every white American immunity from the virus. But we spread it wherever we go" 2020-05-08, Twitter

8. "Young activists have really drawn the link between climate change and white supremacy and capitalism in our country and I think only by understanding the ways that all three of those oppressive systems work together, are we going to be able to begin the process of dismantling them." 2020-09-01, Austin Sierra Club climate forum

9. "Restoration, repairing past harms, is part of my faith tradition. … it's exactly why we need … to invest in black communities, to invest in black Texans" 2026-07-20, DeSoto town hall

10. "I think the Confederate flag is a symbol of treason and terrorism, but the American flag is such a complicated symbol for most of us." 2019-09, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

11. "Defund the police is considered off limits in our political debate when defunding health services, defunding public education has been the stated policy of our state government for decades now." 2020-08-02, Texas Rising

12. "Governor Abbott has filled this special session agenda with far right conspiracy theories about trans children causing problems on sports teams, which we know does not occur in the state of Texas" 2021-07-19, FOX 7 Austin

13. "Are districts getting, you know, almost hopefully near unanimous consent for students to learn about [sex education,] maybe the most important topic that they'll learn about in school?" 2022-07, Texas House Public Education Committee

14. "Every one of our neighbors with a uterus became the property of the state." 2022-10-02, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

15. "God is not a Christian." 2023-10-22, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

16. "So, this idea that to be a Christian means you have to be anti-gay and anti-abortion, there really is no historical, theological, biblical basis for that opinion." 2025-07-18, The Joe Rogan Experience

17. "Jesus is the prophetic voice in my own life, but it could be for you a different prophetic voice from a different faith tradition." 2019-09, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

18. "I oppose voter ID." 2021-07-13, Fox News Primetime

19. "Leasing federal property to abortion clinics on federal lands or in federal offices" 2022-06-24, Letter to President Biden

20. "Did they teach you in Sunday school that Jesus Christ himself was a radical feminist?" 2022-10-02, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

21. "I don't want you in my school doing discipline." 2019-02, The Trey Blocker Show

22. "For me, prophetic voices like Jesus have helped me reckon with my own whiteness, my own masculinity, my own certainty, my own ego." 2019-09, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

23. "That [oil and gas] industry is not gonna last." 2020-09-01, Austin Sierra Club climate forum

24. "Our system of policing is deeply broken. We must replace it with something new and something better." 2020-09-02, Honest Austin

25. "The Bible doesn't mention abortion or gay marriage" 2023-10-22, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

26. "I'm not an expert on this particular case, but I know that there were no Black members of the jury [in Anthony’s case]." 2026-08-05, The Breakfast Club

27. "Our office is the first in the history of the Capitol to add pronouns to our official business cards." 2021-03-31, Twitter/X

28. "If we took just half of what we spend on wars, prisons, and policing, and spent it on education, healthcare, and jobs, we could make prisons obsolete." 2022-04-11, Ferguson prison graduation

29. "Jesus came to transform the world. Christian nationalism is here to maintain the status quo. They have co-opted the son of God. They've turned this humble rabbi into a gun-toting, gay-bashing, science-denying, money-loving, fear-mongering fascist." 2023-10-22, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

30. "In Genesis, God creates life by breathing life into the first human being, which we later call Adam. That life starts when you take your first breath." 2025-07-18, The Joe Rogan Experience

31. "ICE executed a man in broad daylight on our streets just this morning. It's time to tear down this secret police force and replace it with an agency that actually is going to focus on public safety." 2026-01-24, Texas AFL-CIO debate, Georgetown

32. "I'm Season 2 [of Judaism, Christianity and Islam]—the most violent season. My religion has done more damage to both of those religions than they've done to each other." 2026-02-23, The New Yorker

33. "I think there are some folks … that would think that if you deny your child's gender identity that that's incredibly harmful. And whether or not we can—we label it with the term abuse, I mean, it's abusive for sure." 2019-04-03, Texas House Juvenile Justice & Family Issues Committee

34. "Our system, our public education system, particularly here in Texas is not built for poor students. It's not built for students of color." 2020-08-02, Texas Rising

35. "I felt like I didn't have the time or space or training or resources to have the really important conversations with my students … I was trapped in a system that was focused purely on academics, reading, writing, arithmetic." 2020-08-02, Texas Rising

36. "Prison is violence." 2022-04-11, Ferguson prison graduation

37. "But inevitably we're going to spend hours hearing bills that are just kind of conspiracy theory, right, driven, and kind of kooky stuff." 2022-07-26, Texas House Public Education Committee

38. "I know personally that I've learned as much about my faith from Salman's tradition, from the Islamic mystics, from poets like Rumi, as much as I have from Christian authors and Christian writers." 2023-09-16, The State of Belief

39. "God is a verb." 2023-10-22, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

40. "And again, I haven't studied this enough to say this definitively, but there are interpretations of certain passages from the Torah where some folks will even say that there is a, there is some subtle instructions for how to perform an abortion in the ancient world." 2025-07-18, The Joe Rogan Experience

41. "People who're like, "You're in seminary, you're studying to become a minister. Why wouldn't you want the Ten Commandments in every classroom?" … I said I thought the bill was un-Christian." 2025-07-18, The Joe Rogan Experience

42. "Incarnation, by the way, is not just limited to Jesus, it's everybody." 2025-07-18, The Joe Rogan Experience

43. "The Apostle Paul, in his letter to the Galatians, said that in Christ there is neither male nor female. And so, if someone's got a problem with that statement, they shouldn't take it up with me. They should take it up with the Apostle Paul." 2026-04-22, CNN The Lead

44. "An assault weapon ban, a large capacity magazine ban" 2020, Virtual voter meet-and-greet

45. "I don't care what taxes you have to raise, but you're not going to make our students and our teachers, you're not going to make the sick and the elderly pay for this pandemic." 2020-08-02, Texas Rising

46. "Platforms like YouTube, 4chan, and Parlor are radicalizing an entire generation of white boys." 2021-03-18, Twitter/X

47. "Trans children are God's children, made in God's own image. There's nothing wrong with them. Nothing at all. They are perfect. They are beautiful, and they are sacred." 2021-10-14, Texas House

48. "The only person to teach Jesus something was a woman. Even the son of God had something to learn from one of God's daughters." 2022-10-02, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

49. "We only have Jesus because a woman consented to creating him." 2022-10-02, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

50. "Resurrection is when we see Christ in everyone and everything." 2025-04-20, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

51. "Billions of people across the globe celebrate Passover, Easter, and Ramadan. We may use different lyrics, but we are singing the same hymn." 2025-04-20, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

52. "The current administration has grown the size of ICE, Immigration and Customs Enforcement, except it's not people doing Immigration and Customs Enforcement. It is a secret police force that is terrorizing communities." 2025-12-14, Jubilee: Surrounded

53. "I will use every bit of financial and diplomatic leverage that this country has to end the atrocities in Palestine. … I will not use your tax dollars to fund these war crimes." 2025-12-19, Houston campaign town hall

54. "I would not vote to send any offensive weapons to Benjamin Netanyahu that he is currently using to slaughter children in Gaza." 2026-01-24, Texas AFL-CIO debate, Georgetown

55. "And I taught a lot of undocumented students. And those students tended to be my most patriotic students." 2026-03-19, The Bulwark Podcast, Dallas

56. "I think the Supreme Court needs to be overhauled. … I am open to a discussion about expanding the number of justices." 2026-09-09, Fox Special Report, Dallas

57. "The first thing is to elect candidates who recognize institutional racism and are committed to dismantling it." 2018, Reddit AMA

58. "As a Texas legislator, they’re also my constituents. Like so many immigrants throughout our history, undocumented Americans came to this country for the same simple reasons: life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness." 2019-07-12, Twitter

59. "This bill [SB 14, restricting gender-transition care for minors,] I think is the most dangerous bill that's being heard on this floor this session." 2023-05-12, Texas House

60. "Meet Tim Dunn & Farris Wilks—two billionaires from West Texas. … Their ultimate goal is even more ambitious: transforming Texas into an authoritarian, Christian Nationalist state." 2023-10-05, Twitter/X

61. "Jesus lost, and Trump is obsessed with winning. … And on Good Friday, Jesus lost his reputation, lost his ministry, lost his friends, lost his life." 2025-04-20, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

62. "Matthew 25 tells us how we will be judged and saved: by feeding the hungry, by healing the sick, by welcoming the stranger, by visiting the prisoner. Nothing about being a Christian. Nothing about going to church. Nothing about reading the Bible." 2025-04-20, St. Andrew’s Presbyterian Church, Austin

63. "It was a new state curriculum that would teach Christian Bible stories as historical fact, as the only truth to our youngest students, … And to push propaganda, to push indoctrination on those youngest students is deeply immoral and should trouble all of us." 2025-08-05, Faithfully (CAP Action / Interfaith Alliance)

When Starlink became a lifeline for a family fighting to save their dad. ❤️

Nigel Norwood suffered cardiac arrest while camping at a remote beach in Western Australia, about 100 kilometres from the nearest hospital.

There was no mobile signal. His wife, Lynne, spotted another camper’s @Starlink and used it to call emergency services.

“This was the only way to get a call out from the campsite,” she later said.

While she called for help, their 16-year-old son performed CPR with another camper, and their 19-year-old son brought a nearby defibrillator. After three shocks, Nigel’s pulse returned. He received hospital care and recovered.

SpaceX uses ARGON ION PROPULSION to move Starlink satellites through space 

And the engineering is pretty wild

Starlink satellites use argon Hall-effect thrusters  electric engines that ionize argon gas and accelerate the charged particles at extremely high speed

They allow Starlink satellites to:

• Raise themselves into operational orbit
• Maneuver around other spacecraft and debris
• Maintain their position in space
• Deorbit themselves at the end of their life

SpaceX originally used krypton, but switched its next-generation Starlink satellites to argon

The V2 Mini argon thruster produces:

• 170 mN of thrust
• 2.4X the thrust of the first-generation system
• 1.5X the specific impulse

And Starlink became the first spacecraft system to fly using argon propulsion in space

A Falcon 9 gets Starlink into space

Then these tiny electric engines keep thousands of satellites exactly where they need to be

posts.text: Grok @Bot can help with your taxes

quote.author: jasonfreedman
quote.name: Jason Freedman
quote.text:
I just gave my a Grokbot four years of past tax returns and financial files.  Just a dump of folders and unlabled files.

K-1s, 1099s, mortgage statements, HSA records, and every email with our CPA.  266 files.

I just said, please double check my CPA's work.

A few minutes later, it had found a lot of mistakes.

Mortgage interest left off our 2022 return entirely.

HSA payroll contributions counted twice, four years in a row, which created a penalty tax that never should have existed.

A missing IRA form for Jen that would have cost us.

On this year's return: home office errors, two K-1s missing, an outdated 1099, and startup losses we never claimed.

And a retirement contribution the return already deducted...that we hadn't actually deposited.  

I sent it all to our CPA.  They sent back an amended return.  The bot reviewed that too.

One fix went the wrong direction.  The explanation had typos.

Three versions later, all in one afternoon, it said ready to sign.

Just a few hours start to finish.  With about 90 seconds of my time and attention required. I was just the meat proxy hitting send as Grokbot watched the replies in my email.  

Our CPA is great and turned every fix around the same day.  

We chatted afterwards.  He wanted to know what I was using - just normal ole' grokbot.

I asked him what he was using?  No AI tools.  

I set him up with @magnetictax for next season (we're an investor).  All CPAs should be using Magnetic Tax or something like it.  Every single one.

All individuals should be double checking the work and past work with Grokbot or something like that.  

Want to copy the exact the prompt I used?  it was just this:

"Please do a thorough review of my taxes and help me understand if my CPA made any mistakes"

"Think deeply"

Or just tag your bot into this thread.

posts.text:
Suggestion for you:

Pick an agent for work, and pick an agent for personal.

You could explore to do this all with Grok Bot (with many different types of bots)

Personally, I like @bot for work, and @Muse for personal agents.

It helps to create a clean separation for me.

Here are some reasons why Grok for Work:

- Grok is very good at coding, so if you want your bot to help you do engineering / building, Grok beats muse.

- Groks VM / Browser is very strong. I love it for deeper tasks that are work releated.

- Groks integration with X is goated. And I use X heavily for work.

Here are some reasons why @Muse for personal: 

- The simplicity with one agent who knows all is awesome

- The pricing is either free, or very cheap

- They have a history of keeping your private data safe

- They are focused on building personal agents, including training their models this way

- It gives me enough permissions to control my agents at the personal level 

- Building personal software within the app is so easy and well suited for personal use cases 

- Meta is all in on personal agents, which means significant resources being poured into product advancements (your agent gets better every day)

- Muse SDK allowing my agent to go with me on many devices is the right direction

- Meta's Sunglasses gets way more interesting once Muse is supported.
